prevention: NO_MATERIAL_LEARNING_WITHOUT_SKILL_PROJECTION: every material canonical learning must become immediately consumable through the deterministic skill projection before terminal completion.
CANONICAL_LEARNING_IS_AUTHORITY: skills are derived execution projections and never become a second truth source.
SKILL_PROJECTION_DEDUP_BY_FINGERPRINT: repeated learning coalesces by fingerprint and source digest instead of creating duplicate instructions.
SKILL_PROJECTION_FAILS_CLOSED_ON_DRIFT: missing, stale or orphaned projections block terminal completion until reconciled.
PREFLIGHT_CONSUMES_CURRENT_SKILL_PROJECTION: every material chat/agent/skill sees the current projected learning before execution.
BACKFILL_AND_RECONCILE_EXISTING_LEARNING: existing brain/learning history is projected automatically, not only new records.
